description: For the starters (tl-product-saas, tl-product-webapp): one PR per framework release vX.Y.Z that raises TrislabFrameworkVersion and @trislabcompany/framework-ui together, with the npm lockfile. In a product repository the template update raises them instead (tl-product-ideas D-40), so this does nothing there.

hostRules.description: GitHub Packages asks for a token even for a public package, and the app's own token can't read it. The token (classic, read:packages) is the org secret TRISLAB_PACKAGES_TOKEN in the Mend developer portal. It lets the npm manager update the lockfile too.

customManagers.description: The one framework version every Trislab.* NuGet package uses. NuGet has no lockfile here, so a regex manager is enough.

packageRules.description: The NuGet manager would see each Trislab.* package on its own; the regex manager above moves them together.

The framework's NuGet version and its npm package, released with the same version, in one PR. The npm manager reads the registry from the project's .npmrc and updates package-lock.json or pnpm-lock.yaml.
Product repositories take the framework with the template update, never on their own.
